title: andropogon contortus var. allionii
intro: Andropogon contortus var. allionii, commonly known as False Wheat Grass, is a plant species within the Poaceae family, traditionally used in traditional medicine. It has been used to support overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Andropogon contortus var. allionii are attributed to its ability to modulate immune function, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
